The postgraduate key to career success Postgraduate study and master's degrees have tangible benefits and real long-term value. It allows you to gain specialist knowledge of a specific subject and grow your professional network to open any number of doors. Our postgraduate taught degree programmes include Master’s degrees, Postgraduate Diplomas and Postgraduate Certificates. We understand that you might be considering a postgraduate degree for many reasons. It could be a passion for learning, or the drive to launch or accelerate your career, or the desire to refocus your knowledge and skills with a view to changing your career. Whatever your motivations, after completing postgraduate study at City St George's you can go forward with greater confidence. - Accommodation and housing We offer a variety of accommodation options and support services for undergraduate and postgraduate students. - Our local area Explore where we are and our surrounding areas, from nearby stylish cafes, bars and restaurants, to theatres and art venues. - Fees and funding If you’ve got the talent and drive to succeed, we have a number of scholarships, bursaries and loans available to help you meet the cost of university.
